title: Impaired Neuregulin 1 Processing is Associated with Synaptic and Behavioral Abnormalities in a Prenatal Valproic Acid Model of Autism.
abstract: In a prenatal valproic acid rat model, reduced cleaved NRG1 (without transcript change) and decreased sheddases ADAM10/ADAM17/BACE1 attenuated ErbB4-AKT/ERK signalling, reduced synaptic scaffolding, and impaired spine maturation in hippocampus. Recombinant NRG1 restored ErbB4 signalling and improved ASD-relevant behaviours, with sex-specific social deficits.
